content:
@everyone
I need to focus more on my work life this Summer and coming Fall, so I'm going to have a lot less time to participate here, and I need to make sure I don't ever feel like I have responsibilites to tend to here that can distract me from said work. I'm going to need to scale waaaay back in the scope of my participation in this program.

The coordination repo was a fun project, and I learned a lot of valuable things teaching myself how to make it work, but unfortunately the upkeep of it has become too time-consuming, especially considering the April source files were completely incompatible with the framework I had set up.

**Effective immediately my repo is no longer in service.** I'm still going to leave it up on GitHub as-is in case those files are of some use to anyone, but they won't be being updated from here forward, and I won't be doing any compiling work. 

That all being said, I love this game, and this community, and the fun I'm having far too much to leave; so long as no expectations of responsibility remain on my shoulders, I will absolutely continue to be an active member in the program—as the technical writing nerd I joined to be in the first place, lol. Hopefully my absence as coordinator doesn't make things too difficult! <:aurita_beg2:1333982866450681907> <@1470253170209853632> should be able to help anyone who has any questions.
